title: Brown-Stetson-Sanford House

services.name: Trolley Tours
services.desc: On Friday and Saturday mornings learn about our rich assortment of historic houses, churches and the fascinating time Milledgeville was founded to be the new Capital of Georgia with a fully narrated tour of Milledgeville’s historic district. For those interested in exploring the history of the former behavioral health institution, Central State Hospital founded in 1842, a guided tour held on Saturday's is led by a former hospital employee provides a transparent overview of the institution’s multifaceted heritage, current treatment of clients and the ongoing redevelopment of the property. 🚎 Historic Trolley Tour with Milly the Trolley Experience the history of Georgia's former capital

blurb: One of Milledgeville's most significant historic homes, the Brown-Stetson-Sanford House offers a glimpse into life during its era as Georgia's capital and the city's early preservation efforts.
